articles.summary: Alphatec Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: ATEC), a provider of innovative solutions dedicated to revolutionizing the approach to spine surgery, announced today that it will report third quarter 2026 financial results on October 29, 2026, after the market close. The Company will host a live webcast that day at 1:30 p.m. PT / 4:30 p.m. ET. Webcast To access the live webcast, please use this link or visit the Events Presentations section of ATEC’s Investor Relations website. Analyst Participation To participate in the question-and-answer session, analysts must register in advance using this link . After registering, participants will receive access details, including a unique code, via email. Replay A replay of the webcast will be available for 12 months in the Investor Relations section of ATEC’s corporate website. About Alphatec Holdings, Inc.
